notes.note: Bounded scope-presentation delta review: Account/This device/Station storage ownership and reset null-patch behavior are unchanged. Scope text is now a labeled kit Badge with quiet theme tint; Reset is separate from metadata; the mixed group prose is removed and experimental switches have a heading. Existing domain, authorization, SDK and persistence claims are unchanged; this is not a new runtime or whole-document qualification. Follow-up delta at d88ff30efbb: the font row retains its existing store reset and suppresses the duplicate generic reset; other resets are unchanged. Value controls can shrink and wrap beside Reset.108 focused cases and UI typecheck passed; the added mounted-row regression failed with two buttons before the fix and passed with exactly one after it. Independent source review found no actionable issues.
